From: Sara Blake <sara.blake@northwell.com>

Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Q2 billing cutoff — need SF timeline aligned

Rafael —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Finance at Northwell asked me to confirm the final billing cutoff for Q2 so we can align our invoicing. I pulled a quick Snowflake extract and noticed a handful of opportunities still in Negotiation (Stage) with close dates set through July. That will push recognition into Q3 unless we lock the close dates.

Can your team run a quick stage/close-date sweep and tell me which deals you intend to push to Q3 vs. close in this quarter? We’d rather have a short list to review than surprise adjustments at month-end.

If useful, I can share our internal billing calendar (PDF).

Best,
Sara Blake
Finance Manager — Strategic Payments
Northwell Health

Hi Sara —

Appreciate the heads up. I’m looping in Vanessa (ops) and Ben (AE) to run a Salesforce triage this week. Our goal: classify each SFDC opportunity into one of three bins — Close this quarter / Move to Q3 (push) / Needs more info (hold) — and capture the evidence (customer sign-off, PO, DocuSign link).

Action items for internal team:
- Vanessa: run the SFDC filter for Stage in (Negotiation, Contract) and Close Date between 2027-06-01 and 2027-07-15; export as CSV.
- Ben: review assigned opps and annotate next-step and evidence in the CSV row.
- I’ll consolidate and send the list to Sara by EOD Thursday.

I’m attaching a snapshot I exported for initial visibility — SFDC_Q2_pipeline_snapshot.csv. It includes Opportunity ID, ACV, Stage, Close Date, AE.

Sara — once we return the list, can your finance team call out any specific bookings that must hit June 30 for revenue recognition? That will help us prioritize.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Sales, East — Redwood Inference

I also added a priority column for accounts that Sara flagged on our call (Northwell, MedVantage, CruxHealth). Ben — please review your assigned rows in the 'need_more_info' tab and paste any supporting links (DocuSign / PO number / email thread) directly into the "evidence" cell. If you plan to escalate to Legal for a faster signature, mark the row and cc legal-requests@redwood.com.

Want to hold a 15-min sync at 11:00 PT if that helps to triage the borderline ones quickly.

V.O.
